verdict.rationale: Rive versions its runtime SDK APIs and publishes per-runtime migration guides for major versions. These include explicit deprecation notices that name a last-updated version and a replacement, and a feature-support matrix commits to migration notes when API changes are needed. However, this is SDK package versioning only: there is no versioned HTTP API, the OpenAPI spec is a Mintlify sample, and there is no formal deprecation policy with timelines or support windows. Missing for 10: a stated deprecation policy (notice periods, support windows), a versioned service API with a machine-readable spec, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Rive maintains per-runtime migration guides for major versions, including explicit deprecations with a stated last-updated version and replacement
When a feature requires API changes, migration notes will be included below
